body: Kesi S014 claims B-2026-11-01-26 — the durable per-turn execution trace (owner brief 2026-11-01, 'Go ahead' received this session). Build order per the investigation's Deliverable 7: (a) persist the per-turn event stream verbatim (turn_id + seq, existing ObsEvent shape); (b) adapter-level model_call stamps (submit / first byte / last byte, per-call usage + payload size/hash, every path incl. the fast path); (c) path_selected decision events (incl. negative decisions) + context-assembly start/end; (d) persist context_breakdown + post_answer_lanes with the turn; (e) export gains traceRef + history endpoint exposes persisted stage maps; (f) State Explorer renders the trace. One clock discipline (epoch-ms everywhere; monotonic only as labelled deltas). SSE contract NOT widened before the stream persists; projections stay folds of the stream. No overlap with any live peer (only the stale Tobias S004 re-check-in row on the board).
